name: An MCP server for this API, with FastMCP or the official SDK
gain: Other people's agents could call this product through MCP. The gain is a new capability, with no number to state.
how: Only where an agent would plausibly call this API: expose a few read-only endpoints first, with FastMCP in Python or the official MCP SDK in TypeScript. Never expose admin or write endpoints in the first version.
replaces: An HTTP API that agents can only reach through hand-written tools.
trade_offs: A new surface to secure, version and support.
It gives nothing until someone actually points an agent at it.
Worth nothing for an API no agent would call, which is why the pattern is information only.
needs: Python for FastMCP (4.1.4, 27 Oct 2026). For TypeScript, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.2 on npm; the repo says v2 is the stable line and v1.x still gets fixes.

gain_model.formula: no money figure: the call stops working or a capability is missing

verify_rule: The old id or parameter is gone and calls succeed over 7 days

change_recipe.how: Only where an agent would plausibly call this API: expose a few read-only endpoints first, with FastMCP in Python or the official MCP SDK in TypeScript. Never expose admin or write endpoints in the first version.
change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on
